description: This is a Java test class for the Logger utility in the com.anysoftkeyboard.base.utils package. It uses JUnit and Mockito to verify the behavior of the Logger class, including log level support, message formatting, and log buffer management.

classes.name: LoggerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the Logger class functionalities, including log level support, message formatting, and log buffer behavior.
